name: Scrappey · Cookie banners, EU vs US.
alt: Animated infographic: Scrappey, Massive and your code in a stack card. Two browser windows side by side load the same site via Massive, one from the EU (Germany, then France) and one from the US. Each passes a bot check, then its cookie banner slides up: a full EU banner with Accept all, Reject all and Settings, and a thin US bar with a single OK. Each window flashes as it's captured, and the screenshot and Markdown files tick off under Saved. Headline: Cookie banners, EU vs US.
